text:
laura: Hey team — PR #4623 is ready for review: docs + SDK snippet for the new client.auth flow. I want to get this merged before the docs cutoff for v1.8 (2025-05-15). Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/pull/4623 — preview shows a redirect on /sdk/python/auth.md, requesting reviews from @sam and @mike

sam: grabbing it now. quick skim first.

mike: quick Q — should we gate this behind the feature flag 'auth-v1'? the rollout is scheduled 2025-05-12, so if docs go live too early customers might see docs for a not-yet-enabled feature.

laura: good call. I added a note in the PR about the ff. CI preview also failed link checks — see docs-bot below.

jen: docs-bot: Netlify preview build failed: link-checker error: /sdk/python/auth.md references /stable/auth which 404s. stack: link-checker -> http 404.

laura: thanks — I think the link should be /v1.8/auth not /stable. I'll leave small edits but prefer not to push until we align on gating.

sam: minor nit: SDK snippet uses old import style (from redwood import Client). new API is from redwood.client import AuthClient. Also code fence needs language tag. otherwise LGTM.

mike: re: gating — two options: (A) merge now with a clear "experimental / behind feature flag" banner and only enable readers when ff flips; (B) hold until ff rollout and merge in the cutoff window. Ops preference? @nate

nate: release engineer here — docs cutoff for v1.8 is 2025-05-15 23:59 UTC. If this docs content needs to match a release artifact, merge before cutoff. If the service is behind a flag, merging earlier is fine as long as we add a note and do not flip traffic. If you want staged exposure, we can coordinate canary docs pages.

ash: legal/security quick check: need to avoid wording that implies a cryptographic guarantee. change "end-to-end encrypted" to "encrypted in transit and at rest" if applicable. I can approve after that tweak.

jen: pushed patch 4623.1 that fixes the link and updates the snippet to AuthClient usage, added code fence tags. Preview build restarted: https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/pull/4623/preview/2

docs-bot: Preview build succeeded but flagged content-note missing: docs must indicate feature flag name when docs refer to unreleased behavior.

laura: added a short banner at top: "Note: the features described below are gated by feature flag 'auth-v1' and will be rolled out starting 2025-05-12." Also added the wording change per @ash.

sam: lgtm for docs style. one tiny markdown nit on headings but not blocking.

ash: legal approved.

mike: SRE: do we have a rollout plan for docs/feature alignment? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: we can do a canary rollout for the docs and a staged flip for the flag. Suggest: (1) merge with banner, (2) create /docs/canary copy and expose to 5% initially, (3) coordinate with release for full flip after 24h monitoring. We can support the route and monitor errors + link telemetry. :thumbsup:

nate: operational note: if you want this tied to the binary release, ensure the release branch has matching doc commit hash. Otherwise we'll version docs under /v1.8 and point to it in the release notes.

laura: decision: we'll merge after SRE signoff and CI green, add the banner, and schedule merge for 2025-05-14 18:00 UTC to give release engineers time to pin versions. If something else pops, I'll update here. Thanks all :heart:

sam: acked.

jen: merging changes into PR ready for final.

laura: merging on 2025-05-14 18:00 UTC if no blockers. cheers everyone!
